profile.headline: Software Engineer II at FactSet
profile.summary:
A full-stack software engineering new grad. Also knowledgeable in working with the cloud and databases.

I have a heavy interest in Statistics, Data, and AI.

Outside of work I program for games and make gamedev tools in Unity.

positions.title: Software Engineering Extern
positions.description: Completed training in Python. Participated in talks on, AI, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, and the Agile workflow. Competed in a Coding Challenge with a team of other Externs and a FactSet Software Engineer. Communicated and connected with members of various other teams.

volunteerExperiences.role: Member of Engineers Without Borders - RPI
volunteerExperiences.description: Worked on a local project within Troy, NY. Brainstormed possibilities for a community garden. Evaluated options between traditional garden ideas and a greenhouse with automatic irrigation. Balanced potential costs, and labor. Researched  Materials, Garden Health, and different gardening Systems.

projects.title: Nio Studios
projects.description:
was Project Manager

As an art-team member took point in creating a draft for "artwork pipeline" for the art team when hearing about the team manager's concern over lack of satisfactory progress, engaged in setting up a project organization process for the art team, the most well-organized and well-paced team within the studio for months. Promoted to Co-Manager of the art team. 

Recently negotiated for the creation of a management branch for the development studio as a whole after recognizing communication breakdown and project progress dysfunction, and successfully advocated for major reworks to team structure in order to keep the project alive and to ensure adequate progress in the future. 

Currently secured position within the management branch of the development team due to past efforts and prooven ability, and am expected to move from artwork and co-management to full work on project management. Expected to move on from managing the project through Excel files on Google Drive to formal Project Managment software.

organizations.name: Prep for Prep
organizations.description: Prep for Prep develops ethical and effective leaders who reflect our diverse society for the enduring benefit of all. Since 1978, Prep has identified New York City’s most promising students of color and prepared them for placement at independent schools in the city and boarding schools throughout the Northeast. Once placed, Prep offers support and opportunities to ensure the academic accomplishment and personal growth of each one of their students.
